# A6 binned results (generated by redshift_scale.py; do not edit)

Editorial approximation: the curve conversion is an equal-weight projection over an assumed acceleration distribution, not a reproduction of the survey's regression. All χ², p-values and σ equivalents are nominal, conditional on independent bins and the selected bar convention. Calibration and conversion uncertainty are not included in those statistics.

Units: 10⁻¹⁰ m s⁻². Predictions are in MUSE-DARK's convention (McGaugh-function a₀), converted from QI's a_Q over log g_bar ~ N(-10.79, 0.63).

## Uniform mass shift needed for QI to match each bin

| z | published QI (dex) | SPARC-calibrated QI (dex) |
|---|---|---|
| 0.503 | -0.09 | +0.07 |
| 0.825 | -0.12 | +0.04 |
| 1.047 | -0.11 | +0.05 |
| 1.276 | -0.14 | +0.03 |

Best single shift for the published law: -0.113 dex, leaving χ² = 5.4 / 3 (p = 1.5e-01). Negative means the adopted baryonic masses would have to be too large.
